balls.text: Yadav sees the extra bounce and width and tries to slash over the keeper, Akmal leaps up and hangs onto it
slides down the leg side, Yadav gets across and works it on its way wide of long leg
the slower ball, Yadav goes for the slog and misses
misfield! yadav pulls a short delivery over square leg, Jadeja over runs it and concedes a bonus boundary for the Chargers
the yorker turns into a low full toss and Yadav makes him pay by clipping it down to deep square leg
he bangs in the bouncer and that sails way over his head, Rauf is convinced that's an illegal delivery
starts off with a slower one and deceives Yadav as he goes for the slog
the carnage continues as Symonds takes a few paces forward and whips it high over midwicket, one bounce and four
full outside off, he pushes it through the line to extra cover
Symonds is surprised by the extra bounce and checks the pull, he fends it off well in the end and places it wide of midwicket
Munaf loses his line again and dishes out another wide outside off, Symonds lets this one go too
bowls that far too wide outside the offstump, Symonds isn't interested
all timing, Symonds makes room and places it towards Pathan at point who flings himself to his right and fumbles, the ball scorches away to the boundary
low full toss, he opens the face of the bat and glides it down to third man
gives him width outside off and Yadav plays a deliberate glide wide of the keeper
Rohit shapes to cart this over the on side but is foxed by the late turn, he gets a thick leading edge to Salunkhe at extra cover
low full toss down leg, he steps forward and pushes this to long-on
he stays back at the crease waits for the turn and clubs that over deep midwicket
gets a top edge on the sweep but luckily it falls short of the diving short third man
goes back and clips it towards Jadeja at square leg, there's a direct hit but Symonds was safe
Into the second tier! Symonds brings up his ton with a blazing six over deepmidwicket, he stays at the crease and slogs that
jams it on the blockhole outside off, he keeps it out to cover
bowls a slower one wide outside off, he shapes to glide that to third man but misses
backs away and digs out a yorker just past backward point, Pankaj runs across from third man and intercepts it
Munaf dishes out a low full toss, Rohit waits on it and clubs it through the line over the bowler's head, that was all timing
excellent placement, Munaf fires another blockhole outside off, Rohit makes room and digs it out past backward point, there's nobody to cut that off
fires that on the blockhole, he digs it out to the offside, good ball
flighted on middle and leg, he tucks this across the line past square leg
short of a length, he stays back and clubs this past midwicket
gives it too much air, Rohit latches onto a low full toss and clubs it over extra cover
stays back and pushes a good length delivery towards long-on
slides down leg and Symonds gets a deft touch to it as he flicks it just wide of Pankaj at short fine leg
makes room to cut, he ends up chopping it down towards point
Stunning! Yusuf overpitches outside off and Symonds shows scant respect by whipping it over deep midwicket, that's 19 for the over, what power
he overpitches outside off and Symonds drives this forcefully just wide of long-off's reach
Dropped: Symonds makes room outside off and slices it on the up, Yusuf Pathan at point leaps up and gets his fingers to the ball, costly drop that, if only he timed his jump properly
Rohit gets the width outside off and drags this to Salunkhe at midwicket
Free Hit: Symonds goes for the slog a little too early and ends up inside edging it onto his pads, the ball rolls to the offside
the keeper is upto the stumps, he oversteps and Symonds places it to midwicket
Trivedi bowls round the wicket, Symonds makes room and scoops a fullish delivery outside off to the vacant extra cover region, Lalit Modi applauds that
fullish on middle and leg, he tucks this to midwicket
low full toss, the slower ball, he works this to deep midwicket
fullish on leg, he pushes this to long-on
that was one-handed! Rohit stays at the crease and lofts, he doesn't appear to be in full control but manages to clear the long-off rope by an inch
Rohit tries to cut loose, he gets a thick top edge which lobs towards long-on and Pathan runs backwards and fails to get to it
Pankaj overpitches on middle and leg, he pushes it to long-on
makes a bit of room outside off and glides it straight to short third-man, couldn't pierce the gap there
Rohit goes for the slog sweep but ends up placing it straight to midwicket
cuts back on the pace, he pushes it to long-off
fetch that! Symonds picks the flight on middle and leg and clobbers it 74 m over the deep midwicket boundary
flighted outside off, he pushes it towards deep extra cover, they run well and pick up two
Rohit gives him the charge and pushes with the turn to long-on, there's a fumble but the batsmen are content with a single
Salunkhe commits a crime by dishing out a half tracker outside off and Symonds obliges by staying back and clubbing this over cow corner
floated on middle and leg, he works his wrists and tucks this wide of midwicket
makes room to cut, he mistimes it and chops it down towards slip
stays back at the crease and tucks this to midwicket for a quick single
gets forward and pushes this through the line to long-on, that's the 100 up
defends on the up back to the bowler
lofts this with brute force just past warne's reach and places it to the long-off boundary, that's his fifty
take that! Symonds latches onto an overpitched delivery, slogs across the line and carts it high over long-on
loses his line and slides way down leg
slides way down leg, he gets down to sweep and he makes faint contact, Salunkhe at short fine leg cuts it off
holds the length back, he stays on the backfoot and tucks it to midwicket
drifts on the pads this time and he clips this against the turn to midwicket
pushes this one a little flat, he uses his wrists and clips it to square leg
another slower one, this time a low full toss, Rohit works it away to long-on and retains the strike
another slower ball, short and on the off, Rohit steers it to short third man
slammed down the ground, long-on keeps it down to a single
slower ball, Symonds gets into position for a pull but is beaten
slightly short of a length, Symonds gets on top of the bounce and pulls it for a welcome boundary
outside off, and sent down to third man for a single
very short ball that, Rohit tries to turn it to the leg side, chips it on the up, long-on runs in and keeps the batsmen to a single
comes on a little quicker, Symonds whips it to mid-on for a single
Rohit Sharma gets off the mark with a back foot drive to the off
And Shane Warne has done it.. no foot work from Laxman, stays at the crease and drives away from his body and he gives the simplest of return catches
single to Pankaj singh at deep extra cover
short ball, didnt turn much, Symonds makes room and punches to mid-off
drive on the off, another single
short ball, Laxman pulls it from outside off, Yusuf Pathan runs across and cuts it off at the midwicket boundary
good length on off, Symonds drives it powerfully down to long-off for a single
short ball on off, Laxman pokes it to third man for a single
pulled to midwicket, single results
Trivedi is welcolmed to the crease by a massive hit, Symonds clobbers it over long-on
slightly short, Symonds clubs it to midwicket where Graeme Smith is positioned
slow yorker, Symonds keeps it out, no run and this is turning out to be a great first over from Pankaj
Slower ball, slanting to leg, Laxman guides it to fine leg for a single
Laxman nudges it to cover, fielder pounces on it quickly, prevents the single
a bit of width and Symonds runs it down to third man for a single
strays down leg, fortunate to get away with that, it glances Symonds' pads and goes to the keeper
pushes it to mid-on and a quick single is taken
short of a length, Symonds fends it to the vacant fine leg region for four
that wasn't that good, bangs it in but is ill-directed and results in a wide down leg
Superb spell this from Watson, back of a length and jags back into Symonds, another dot ball
keeps it full, Symonds digs it out to cover, no run results
Symonds makes room for himself and bludgeons it past a diving mid-off and the fifty comes up
slanting into his pads, taps it to midwicket
on-drive from Laxman, immaculately timed, two fielders give chase but the despairing dive at the boundary fails to keep the ball in
a bit of width, Symonds slashes it, Kaif tries to stop it at point, Watson gives chase and a superb dive keeps the batsmen to three
a rarity in Twenty20, Symonds shoulders arms to one just outside off
stays at the wicket, smacks the half-volley to the extra-cover boundary
makes room and scoops over cover, Watson tries to catch it but to no avail as it races for four
wide outside off, Symonds slashes it towards point, big misunderstanding between the batsmen, both stuck mid-pitch but Kaif throws misses the stumps
bangs in another bouncer and Laxman ducks, superb over, just the one run
holds the length back outside off and Laxman whips this one straight to Smith at short midwicket
the slower ball, Laxman uses his wrists and clips this to mid-on again
offers the full face of the bat and times this well straight to mid-on
tests him out with a bouncer and the ball sails over his arched back
full on middle and leg, he softly taps it back to mid-on
that's two for the over! Pathan flights it slow on middle stump, Afridi tries to go downtown and mishits this one, Jadeja takes the skier at mid-on
shot boss! Pathan flights it on middle and leg, he gets on his knee and executes a slog sweep and the ball sails over fine leg, all brute power
flighted outside off, he reaches out for the drive and gets a thick outside edge which flies over gully
flighted on middle and leg, he sweeps to fine leg

beats him in flight, Pathan tosses it up ever so slowly, that's his stock delivery, it lands on a good length and Gilchrist comes forward for the loft but is beaten all ends up, Kamran Akmal does the rest
overpitches outside off and he pushes this to Salunkhe at extra cover
brilliant! Watson overpitches on the pads and Laxman turns his wrists slightly and creams this past the bowler and mid-on
fullish on the pads, he pushes this towards mid-on
defends it back to the bowler but exposes his stumps a little, dangerous
classy, he overpitches on the pads and he uses his wrists well and flicks this wide of square leg, that traveled fast off the bat
awesome fielding there! Yusuf Pathan flings himself to his right at extra cover and intercepts a fierce cover drive
the famous wrist comes into play early as he drags this from outside off and places it to fine leg
what a start, Munaf bowls a low full toss on middle and Gilchrist just works it on its way and flicks it between mid on and midwicket
Munaf aims for a yorker but misdirects it down his pads, Gilly merely gets a deft touch as he flicks it down to fine leg
lands on a fullish length on the pads, he whips this across the line to midwicket
lands on a length, he firmly pushes this to mid-off
and Deccan are underway! Munaf overpitches outside off and Gilchrist drives on the up and bisects the gap between mid-off and cover, the cheerleaders have an early workout
starts off with one that pitches outside off and seams away, no wide called

the captain blazes and what a sensational win! Warne steps down the track and carts a half volley just over the deep extra cover rope. All players in the dug out rush onto the field and Yusuf Pathan jumps on top of Warne, the guys in blue are simply ecstatic
Goodness! Warne steps down and clubs that high into the second tier over deep midwicket, how that changes things!
he charges down and creams a low full toss over the bowler's head, the fielder tries to get a boot to it but the ball beats him
low full toss, he steps down and pushes that to lonbg-off
he takes a few paces down the track and clubs a high full toss to deep midwicket
makes room to clobber that over the on side but RP fires in the yorker, he digs it out towards point
on the blockhole outside off, he keeps it out towards point

Warne moves across his stumps to distract RP, he fires that down leg and Warne drives straight to Laxman at cover, Salunkhe sets off for a suicidal run but Warne sends him back, it's too late as RP whips off the bails
fires in a yorker, he keeps it out and RP gets a finger to it and deflects towards mid-off
the middle stump is out! RP fires in a yorker on the base of middle stump, Jadeja makes room to dig it out but is beaten for pace, the middle stump goes back by a yard or two
makes room and RP follows him by cramping him for width, he drives square but Bangar slides and intercepts it at point
excellent start to the over as RP fires that on the blockhole on the pads, he backs away and gets a thick edge onto his pads
fires that on the blockhole and Warne gets a thick outside edge and beats short third man
fires that on middle and leg, he fails to put that away
fires that at 115 kph, warne shapes to cut but is beaten for pace
Dropped: Kalyankrishna drops a skier at deep midwicket! Jadeja goes the slog and gets a thick top edge, Afridi forgives him for that lapse, nice gesture
what have we here?? Afridi gets away with a low full toss and Smith goes for a rather tired heave, he fails to get the elevation and Kalyanakrishna takes it easily at deep midwicket
slides the quicker one wide down the leg side
could this be a turning point here? Afridi pitches that on a good length and Kaif tries to slam that over long-on, he mishits it and Symonds takes the offering easily at long-on
full outside off, he scoops it hard towards the bowler and Vaas fails to catch that, that was struck very firmly for Vaas to react
directs the slower ball onto his body and he gets a thick edge onto his pads while attempting a slog
Smith makes room and flat bats it on the one bounce to long on
the slower ball, he bowls that on a good length and Kaif taps it to the covers and gets off the strike
makes room, he's cramped for width as he chops it down towards the covers
Vaas strays on the pads and he feeds it on Smith's favourite area as he whips that over midwicket with ease, one bounce and four
Kaif rubs it further as he latches onto a half volley outside off and scoops this over backward point, there's nobody patrolling the boundary to cut that off
the slower ball outside off, he waits back at the crease and cuts it wide of extra cover
full and wide outside off and a thick outside edge just beats short third man, that was a safe stroke
one low full toss too many as Smith waits on it and bashes it over long-on, that flew off the meat of the bat
the slower ball, he pushes the low full toss firmly to deep midwicket
Smith again makes room but clubs it straight to long-on, he's struggling to meet the boundaries here
and another! Symonds holds the length back but it fails to pay off as kaif picks the length early and biffs it over long-on
bang! Kaif steps down and lofts that high over the bowler's head, Symonds is getting creamed here
fires that down leg as Smith makes room, he sweeps but fails to beat short fine leg
full outside off, he pushes that towards cover
pushed to the off side
bangs it short and Kaif waits on it and bludgeons it high over deep midwicket
Afridi gets lucky with a poor delivery, slides down leg, Smith pulls but fails to pierce short fine leg
makes room and cuts that wide of point, Smith scampers back for the second run and gets to his fifty
Smith backs away to whack that but Afridi follows him and cramps him for room, he ends up chopping it to the on side
fired on middle and off, he gets forward and pushes this wide of cover
Smith makes room to loft but checks his stroke as he chips it on the first bounce to long-on
takes a few paces down and clips that wide of midwicket
full outside off, he steps down and pushes this to Rohit at long-off, he fires in the throw and restricts them to a single
steps down the track and gets an inside edge onto his pads, Kaif was deceived in flight
he errs by bowling a quicker one wide outside off, he makes room and slices it past backward point
Smith pushes a full delivery through the line to long-on, Deccan have picked themselves in the field after picking up two quick wickets
bowls the slow offcutter, he waits on it and punches it to long-on
slides on the pads, he whips that behind square on the on side
through the gate! Afridi bowls the quicker one and gets it to angle into watson, he goes for the slog sweep but misses it completely and the ball crashes onto the stumps
Afridi's firing in his medium pacers, Smith goes for the pull but gets a leading edge towards long-off
full outside off, he pushes that to long-off
this was like a medium pacer, Smith is beaten for pace as he tries to pull and gets a thick edge which deflects off his pads to the offside
fires in the quicker one and cramps him for room, he glides it to short third man and sets off for a quick single
stays on the backfoot and clips this behind square on the on side
stays on the backfoot and clips it with the turn to midwicket
no turn as the ball lands outside off and straightens, Smith shapes to cut but misses
flighted on middle and leg, Smith stays at the crease and slogs this over the bowler's head, super shot
pitches this outside off and gets away with a wide as Smith reaches out to chase it
pitches on middle and leg and turns a little, he steps down and flicks it to square leg
Ojha sees him coming down the track and pitches it short, Smith checks his stroke and pushes it towards long-on
watson fails to pick the high full toss and ends up pushing it tamely back to the bowler
pitches that on the blockhole, Smith pushes that to long-on
slides it on the pads, he whips it across the line to deep midwicket
and a huge sigh of relief for Deccan as Pathan goes! It was a rank half tracker outside off, Pathan stays at the crease, reaches out and plays an ugly flat-batted swipe straight to Symonds at long-on
another low full toss and Smith reaches out and creams this to long-on
bowls a low full toss and he clubs that hard to long-on
pushes this towards cover, Pathan sets off but Smith sends him back, Pathan intercepts the throw
the carnage continues as Smith gets on his knee and slogs Afridi over his head, RP runs across and stretches his hand out in vain to pull off a blinder
Smith deftly glides a short delivery down to third man, that's the fastest hundred in the IPL
stays back and flat-bats that one over the bowler's head
pushes in the quicker one, Pathan shapes to slog but gets a thick inside edge onto his pad
makes room and cuts a short of a length delivery wide of short third man
everything's going Pathan's way as he mis-hits one high over backward  point, it appeared as if someone would catch it but Pathan just got lucky there
full and spanked back with force and RP does very well to stop that, good reflexes there
and he follows it up with a thump over extra cover, RP errs by overpitching, Pathan's biffing them around here
Pathan isn't done yet, he gets a juicy half tracker and pounds that over long-on, that's a 50 off 21 balls, the fastest in the tournament so far
makes a bit of room and drags a yorker out towards long-on
comes round the wicket and bowls that on the blockhole, he digs it out towards point
good slower ball, Smith checks his stroke and pushes it back to the bowler
low full toss, mistimes it and it runs away square on the leg side
Big hit from Yusuf, the boundaries may have been pulled in but these sixes are going well into the stands, again over midwicket
good ball, yorker just outside off, dug out to Bangar at point
trademark Smith shot, drags it from outside off and pulled to midwicket
short ball, pulled to midwicket for a single
stroked down the ground for a single, and the gamble of bringing Ojha on within the Powerplay hasn't worked
another swipe from the batsman, that kept a touch low and the batsman misses it completely
Huge hit, Yusuf launches that into the stands
low full toss, Smith gets a single
another four, comes down the track and chipped over mid-on this time
round the wicket, on a length on leg, Smith makes rooms hits over mid-off
finished off with a glide to short third man for a single
Graeme Smith gets into the act, Rajasthan aren't going down without a fight, makes room and blasts it through the covers
overpitched on the pads, pushed to long-on
four this time, creamed past mid-off
slower ball, Yusuf picks it and smashes another six
thrusts his foot forward and launches it over the bowler's head
charges down the track, follows the line of the ball and pushes it wide of mid-on
well-bowled, yorker angling into off stump, squirts to the leg side and batsmen scamper a single
Yusuf throws his bat at it, no contact
and that was a poor delivery, very,very wide outside off
width outside off, and Yusuf lofts it through the line and carves it over long-off
short ball and Yusuf clubs that over mid-on for a boundary
full and wide outside off, he creams it straight to extra cover
Smith gets off the mark with a streaky shot, low full toss and he makes room and edges it over slip
Just one run in this over so far, Vaas is doing a tremendous job here
budges it to cover and steals a quick single
wafts at one outside off, no contact
inside-edge on to the pad, pops up and nearly a return ctach
Got him, Akmal's powerful slice finds Sanjay Bangar at backward point, who takes a good catch
and again, RP came back well in that over after being hit for six off the first
Smith defends it to off, he's yet to get off the mark
outside off this time and Akmal pushes it to square for a single
big appeal from RP, full length and yorks Akmal marginally outside leg, runs away to third man
good comeback, played to point, no run
pitches full on leg, Akmal clips it over square leg for a six.. they'll need more of this to chase down Hyderabad's score
defended towards cover
Smith pushes his first ball to mid-on
Akmal throws his bat at that, takes a thick outside edge and flies down to third man, RP Singh makes a brilliant effort but fails to complete the catch.. what a start to this innings!
scythed down the ground, races between mid-off and cover for a boundary
steers it to Rohit Sharma at point, no run

A dramatic start, Kamran Akmal punches the first ball down the wicket, and it hits the stumps at the other end, with Graeme Smith out of the crease, Hyderabad are appealing, but there's some doubt about whether Vaas got a boot on it, third umpire rules it not out
